method: Candidate ERA5-Land 0.1-degree cells are staged against the complete 1991-2020 hourly series before any published snapshot is replaced. Route sources establish the intended hiking scope; they do not by themselves approve a model-grid coordinate.

controls.reason: Re-download the unchanged Hunza cell in the same run to determine whether its September-to-October temperature jump is reproducible from the official source response.

zermatt.label: official Zermatt-Sunnegga route candidate cell
zermatt.reason: The candidate model cell intersects the official Zermatt-Sunnegga GPX route, which runs from the village at 1,608 m to Sunnegga at 2,279 m. It is intended to replace the adjacent permanent-snow cell. Full 1991-2020 climate validation remains required before approval.

evidence.title: Zermatt-Sunnegga via Tiefenmatten (official Zermatt Tourism)
evidence.observation: The official route runs from 1,608 m to 2,279 m and provides its downloadable route geometry.

evidence.title: Zermatt-Sunnegga official GPX
evidence.observation: The official route geometry runs approximately from 46.0236 N, 7.7481 E to 46.0170 N, 7.7703 E and intersects the selected 0.1-degree model cell.

el-chalten.label: El Chalten lower-trail candidate cell
el-chalten.reason: Staging candidate selected from the pinned ERA5-Land invariant field at about 698 m to replace a Southern Patagonian Ice Field cell. The official park trail network starts in El Chalten and includes valley and viewpoint routes; coordinate-level route QA remains required before approval.

evidence.title: Los Glaciares National Park north-zone trail map (Argentina National Parks)
evidence.observation: The official map documents trails from El Chalten, including Laguna de los Tres with 750 m ascent and several shorter valley viewpoints.

garhwal.label: Garhwal trekking candidate cell
garhwal.reason: Staging candidate selected from the pinned ERA5-Land invariant field at about 3,149 m to replace a permanent-snow cell. It targets non-glacier trekking elevation in Garhwal; coordinate-level route QA remains required before approval.

evidence.title: Valley of Flowers (Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board)
evidence.observation: The official destination page describes the trekking approach and a valley hiking scope around 3,600 m.

denali.label: official Denali Savage River trail candidate cell
denali.reason: The candidate model cell intersects the official NPS Savage Canyon Trail geometry and replaces a permanent-snow cell near the Denali massif. Full 1991-2020 climate validation remains required before approval.

evidence.title: Hiking in Denali (U.S. National Park Service)
evidence.observation: NPS identifies Mountain Vista, Savage River Loop and Savage Alpine as established hiking routes in the park-road corridor.

evidence.title: Savage River Area Trails official NPS map configuration
evidence.observation: The NPS map links its authoritative Savage Canyon Trail geometry and centers the hiking area near 63.733 N, 149.264 W.

evidence.title: Savage Canyon Trail official NPS geodata
evidence.observation: The published trail geometry spans approximately 63.740-63.751 N and 149.290-149.294 W, intersecting the selected 0.1-degree model cell.

annapurna.label: Annapurna circuit candidate cell
annapurna.reason: Staging candidate selected from the pinned ERA5-Land invariant field at about 3,130 m to replace a cell roughly 1,300 m above much of the trekking corridor. It targets a middle-elevation circuit climate; coordinate-level route QA remains required before approval.

evidence.title: Annapurna Region (Nepal Tourism Board)
evidence.observation: The official overview describes the circuit, Manang approach, shorter treks and the region's very broad elevation range.
